Action.default: Trade direction: Call bets the price will rise, Put bets it will fall.

AssetType.default: Category of a trading asset: stock, currency, commodity, cryptocurrency or index.

CandleLength.default: A candle duration (in seconds) allowed for an asset.

Asset.default: A tradable asset with its symbol, payout percentage, activity status and allowed candle durations.

Deal.default: A trade (open or closed) with its prices, timestamps, direction and profit information.

PendingOrder.default: A pending order waiting for its trigger time/price, including the ticket used to cancel it.

Candle.default: An OHLC candle: symbol, timestamp, open, high, low, close and optional volume.
